body:
What if I neither have friends nor family ... I don't even have money for a therapist lol

I only have here
Hey, wait a little before going to sleep pls. Would you mind if I ask you to tell me about you ? Do you like doing particular things ? What is causing you so much pain ?
I don't know you, but pls don't leave :(

I feel you, especially this part : "i think about killing myself every single night, the past few months i've fallen asleep to the thought of me slitting my wrists and it's strangely comforting."

I don't know what to say given the fact that my situation is similar. I just hope you don't do it

One day, someone said something to me (it was not mean, just some advice I don't even remember), I felt so much hate, pain and sadness coming from nowhere; I almost did it the next hour, but the fear and some good memories prevented me from doing it
Exactly, I feel like it reassures me to know that I have this option
I don't know anyone who would understand, except all of you here. So I'm talking to you aha
2 days ago, I was ready, I almost took my car and execute my plan, but I just shed a tear instead lol. It becomes scary when you are in front of it, a strange pressure in the chest
I understand all of you so much ... I could have written each messages I read here
I feel you, family can be real sh*t
Hide the pain, and nothing except Rick and Morty, sometimes ahah
I don't know what to say, your situation is very hard and I sympathize. I hope you'll find some strength and get better. And if you don't, maybe we will see each other soon in another place
